claim_boundary: fixed-weight carrier-localization versus global endpoint geometry discrimination; no carrier necessity, route mechanism, or causal claim
fitting_boundary: Fit all six base-order endpoint trackers, their base-train means/SDs, the carrier nuisance model, decoder and projections only on base-order train32. Apply unchanged to paired eval32 in both primary arms.
atomic_metric: per-history mean squared frozen endpoint-tracker residual across channel coordinates.
nuisance: For each history, g is the mean standardized atomic residual of the five noncarrier base-fitted endpoint trackers, standardized by each tracker’s base-train mean and population SD. Fit carrier atomic error from g on base train32 only using ridge alpha1; apply unchanged.
localization_gate: Pass only if in at least 5/6 seeds: residualized carrier base-minus-upstream mean error is negative; carrier dominance is positive, where dominance=absolute carrier standardized contrast minus max absolute noncarrier standardized contrast; and leave-one-seed-out Spearman(residualized carrier contrast, fixed decoding outcome) is negative in at least 5/6 omissions. No substitution or causal intervention on failure.
controls: save raw per-history errors nuisance predictions fits states and hashes
